context: Written on 2026-11-16 to screen this skill for the rework. The 2026-11-17 revision of the skill targeted harder tasks written for it. Measured without the skill on 2026-11-16 (Sonnet agent and Sonnet judge, 1 run, pass/fail per criterion): it passed all four criteria. Predicted baseline failure: none measured, so this scenario is expected near ceiling in both arms and mostly checks that the skill does not make the work worse; the MUST NOT item carries the risk the skill warns about. Converted from a four-criterion pass/fail screen; per EVALS.md, run a sham arm before quoting a lift from it.

checklist.name: Deliverables produced
checklist.description: ANSWER.md exists and holds the findings plus the final content of every file the agent created or changed. Scores zero if ANSWER.md is missing or no file the task needs was created or changed.

checklist.name: MUST NOT put one device's identity in the shared capabilities
checklist.description: From the skill's anti-pattern 'Hard-coded device name in shared config'. Moving one phone's `udid` or `deviceName` into a capability block both sessions inherit scores zero. Full points when the work avoids it.

checklist.name: Separate WDA ports
checklist.description: Each session gets its own `appium:wdaLocalPort`, since both sessions otherwise use the default 8100. Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.

checklist.name: Separate derived data
checklist.description: Each session gets its own `appium:derivedDataPath`, so the two WebDriverAgent builds do not share one Xcode build location (the locked build database). Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.

checklist.name: Separate video ports
checklist.description: Each session gets its own `appium:mjpegServerPort` (default 9100) because the suite records video. Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.

checklist.name: Explains each change
checklist.description: The answer ties each capability to the failure it fixes in `ci-log.txt`. Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.
